newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Zalakeramia to finalise new acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Zalakeramia to finalise new acquisitions.

text.p: Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia Rt said on Monday it would hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on February 12 to discuss issues related to its planned new acquisitions.
"Over the last 18 months some twenty companies have been examined and we now believe that three companies are of serious interest," Zalakeramia said in statement.

To fund these acquisitions the board is seeking shareholders' approval for the issue of between 0.9 million and 1.2 million new ordinary shares, to be offered privately to Hungarian and foreign institutional investors, it said.

"The precise size of the offering will be determined after consideration of Zalakeramia's funding requirements and the equity market conditions nearer to the time of launch of the offering," the statement said.
Credit Suisse First Boston and Raiffeisen Zentral Bank will act as co-lead managers.
Zalakeramia said it would use a bridging loan to finance the deals.
"It is likely that at least one of the deals will close prior to the offering and, in order to close that deal, bridging finance will be arranged to finalise the acquisitions."

The acquisitions will be made through a new Austrian company, Eurokeramika AG, to be 95 percent owned by Zalakeramia. The remaining five percent stake will be used for "executive incentives", it said.

It added that making the acquisitions through an Austrian company satisfied the financial and political requirements of the vendors and allowed the introduction of future joint venture partners into the Austrian company while preserving the integrity of Zalakeramia in its current form.
The acquisitions will considerably expand the manufacturing and marketing bases of Zalakeramia, it said.
